name: Downstream Latency Degradation
description: Injects 250ms latency into backend dependencies to test client timeout tolerances.
expectedBehavior: Client P95 increases but error rate remains 0.0% without socket drops.

name: Intermittent 500 Fault Bursts
description: Injects 20% transient 500 errors into API endpoints to verify retry mechanisms and circuit breakers.
expectedBehavior: Client fallback handling activates; circuit breaker trips before complete outage.

name: High Concurrency DB Lock Contention
description: Exhausts database connection pool to test backpressure and queue timeouts.
expectedBehavior: Graceful 429 Too Many Requests / 503 rather than unbounded thread deadlock.
